summary: Both previously failed items now pass on fresh runs. The ledger-line gate holds: hud_renders.mjs --at 100 and --at 160 both exit 0, with SkyLedger at 1 render for 1 change of its numbers. A harder stress test also passes. 8 forced renders of the sky strip itself (forceUpdate, which bypasses every sCU) and 9 HUD-root re-renders caused 0 SkyLedger renders. The line still updated with correct numbers on real changes, never stale for even one frame over 1,201 frames. The Settings toggle hides and restores it live. Regression check: typecheck is clean, and the RIFT e2e journey passes end to end with 0 console errors (Dial Bar key labels present, ledger on screen, no overlap with the objective chips). The STORE step fails the same way as round 1: a single-mode run earns 444 Candles, which buys no skin. That is a harness limit, not a regression. One accuracy note on the refix's evidence: preact's options.diffed also fires on sCU bail-outs, so 'SkyStrip and Hud rendered 2x' in the refix's --at 160 report counts diffs, not real renders of the strip. My forced-render phase covers the case it was meant to show.
